verdict.rationale: kitty documents programmatic surfaces you can build against: a Python extension API for writing kittens, and a scriptable remote-control CLI and protocol. A hands-on probe confirmed the remote-control loop works end to end (list state as JSON, send text, read output back, close the window). These are extension and control interfaces, though, not packaged official SDKs or client libraries, and no OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: official language SDK/client libraries, SDK reference docs, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probe 404), independent corroboration of SDK-style development.
